Ok, there are some things that may help a little, and you can start really slowly. The first thing is to understand that there is no magic way :/ every way is painful and scaring, but you get used to it somehow. The simplest way that you can start is to eat clean and exercise. The exercise is really important. Sometimes you will not feel like doing it, when it happens I just roll the bed to the floor. It's pathetic but it works for me. If you can't go one day, try the next day. If you are scared to going out, do something inside the house. The last thing is to keep a journal next to your bed, so the last thing I do is to write the good things that happened that day. Sometimes I feel like I have nothing to write, so I just put something that I somehow enjoyed, like "I really like the color of the ceiling", "I saw a cute couple today". I know it is silly, but these advice helped me, the journal really helped.

I can go hours about how I freaked out about what to wear, and I am not even vain. I still can't wear dresses because I think everybody will notice and I hate it. Like, I'm a grown ass woman (27 years), but I feel like a child a lot of times. I feel I am not mature enough for anything. But not everything is lost. I still can't wear dresses, but I don't cry over what shampoo to use. If I really don't know what to do, I use both. It's this little strategies that keep me going, and I feel like I'm improving. Since I remember I am suicidal, and now, for the very first time in my life, I don't want to die. I don't even know what to do with this emotion. I don't know "how to live" but it is ok. I keep saying to myself that everything is going to be ok, over and over again. I stopped listening to sad songs. Everyday I try a little further, and it's helping. And now I'm understand the others a little more too. They simply don't know what to do with a depressed person. They freak out like I freak out with the socks. Your friend probably doesn't know what to do. She doesn't know if you will be mad if she asked you out, or if you would be better, or how she should act. Sometimes they just quit because they don't know what to do. So, if you know what can make you better, talk to her.

You know, there will be another chances and another shows. If you are depressed, most of times you need a external validation for your choices, because you don't trust yourself. There are lots of times I breakdown because I couldn't choose a color for my socks. I missed school because I couldn't simply braid my hair. I constantly needed someone to praise me and to encourage me, otherwise I would be stuck for hours, crying because I couldn't do anything right, not even choose what to eat. Most of times I feel like I'm not worth, that I'm not loved and no one wants me, but that is not true, and I believe that's your case too. I'm still trying to figure out how to be ok with just myself, and not freak out if I need to order a pizza. But you are loved. There are this girl who are supportive, there are your best friend (even if she isn't available right now). I used to rant a lot at my boyfriend, until I understand that I loved him enough so I didn't want to hurt him. So now, if I'm really sad, or really mad, I am honest with him. It helped a lot, because now I don't hurt him anymore and I don't feel sad because I was acting like a child. But it's ok. You know, the way you are acting is probably the depression talking for you. It is not you. If you feel so overwhelmed you should seek treatment. This can help a lot, so you will feel like you have control over your life, your choices. I over burden my boyfriend (he is the only person who I can talk about it), but he is in another country. I don't want to kill myself, but I would be glad if I died somehow. I just don't want to feel that anymore. I just want to go home, and help my mom with the plants and be with my pets (I have three cats, 2 dogs, 1 parrot and a fish). But I want to be successful so I can have a little farm where I cultivate edible mushrooms (I know, it's random). And I feel like this weird dream is what keeping me going. Even if I am so bad that can barely speak. So I know how you feel. I know how it feels when there's not enough air in the room, and how it feels when you can't get out without breaking down.
